title: Associate AI Engineer – Front End
description:
**We're looking for a** 
****Associate AI Engineer – Front End****
**This role is** 
**Office Based, Hyderabad Office**
 We are seeking a Frontend Associate AI Engineer with 1–3 years of experience with strong frontend experience in React/Next.js and hands on experience in AI/ML model development, including RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) architectures. The role involves building scalable web applications, integrating AI\-driven backend services, optimizing performance, and contributing to enterprise\-grade platforms that handle complex data and real\-time updates.
   

  

**In this role you will…**
* Develop and maintain frontend applications using React.js and Next.js.
* Develop, implement, and optimize machine learning and AI models
* Implement RAG architectures to enhance AI solutions with knowledge retrieval for enterprise applications.
* Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate AI/ML solutions via APIs.
* Build reusable, responsive UI components with clean architecture.
* Integrate REST/GraphQL APIs from AI/ML backends, with proper error handling.
* Manage application state and asynchronous data flows.
* Optimize performance, accessibility, and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Write unit and component tests using Jest and React Testing Library.
* Debug and resolve production issues in collaboration with backend and product teams.


**You Have What It Takes If You Have…**
**Core Technologies**
* React.js – Hooks, lifecycle, context API
* Next.js – Routing, SSR/SSG fundamentals
* TypeScript – Type safety, interfaces, generics
* JavaScript (ES6\+) – Async/await, modules
* Modern CSS – Tailwind CSS / SCSS, responsive design
* Machine learning frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn
* Experience in RAG architectures
* Familiarity with large language models (LLMs)
* State management (Context API, SWR or React Query)
* Build tools (Webpack or Vite), npm/yarn
* Git\-based version control workflows


**Testing**
* Jest
* React Testing Library
* Basic understanding of end\-to\-end testing (Playwright preferred)


**Data \& API Integration**
* REST API consumption (OpenAPI/Swagger familiarity preferred)
* Basic knowledge of GraphQL (queries/mutations)
* Experience with chart libraries (Chart.js or similar preferred)


**Cloud \& DevOps Exposure**
* Docker (basic containerization knowledge)
* Exposure to CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions)
* Basic understanding of cloud environments (AWS preferred)
* Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and performance tracking


**Our Culture**
 Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
   

  

**Who We Are**

**About Vida**
 What are we trying to solve?
   

  

 We have 7\.5 billion people on Earth, of which over 1 billion cannot securely prove their identity right now.
   

  

 Every year, 140 million babies are born, of which 40 million go unregistered.
   

  

 Simply put, these people are deprived of social benefits, such as education and health, their civil rights to vote and travel; and are excluded from the economy because they cannot sign up for bank accounts, loans, welfare programs etc. We believe this is unacceptable and needs to change.
   

  

 At VIDA, we are creating a frictionless digital identity system. One that fulfills the needs and expectations of our times, and is available anywhere, for everyone.
   

  

 Why are we solving this problem?
   

  

 The United Nations (UN) and World Bank ID4D initiatives aim to provide everyone on the planet with a legal identity by 2030\. This deadline is just 9 years away, we are expecting a digital identity to be a legal human right by then and we at VIDA want to be pioneers in leading this change.
   

  

 Who are we?
   

  

 We are a highly driven bunch of people to solve this problem for our own reasons. Whether it is to solve for misleading doctors, or because we didn’t get access to fair ration due to corruption \- Our collective goal aligns.
   

  

 Other things that we care about:
   

  

* Our mission is to enable trust, so what we do is pretty serious stuff – we work hard and we have audacious goals. We balance it through humor and making sure we have fun at work. We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously.
* We are a startup so at times we will do things that are outside our scope. We do it to learn but we also do it because it takes a village.
* We believe feedback is a gift and should be given freely, constructively, and in a respectful manner.
* We are accountable to many stakeholders, but first and foremost, we are accountable to our mission and each other

description:
**Position Overview**

* Testing \& Debugging: Develop unit tests and debug embedded software using JTAG, GDB, and hardware debugging tools
* Code Maintenance: Fix bugs in existing switching software and perform code reviews with senior team members
* Documentation: Create and maintain technical documentation for implemented features and protocols
* Hardware Integration: Assist in integrating software with switching hardware platforms across different speed grades

**Technical Requirements**

* Network Protocols: Fundamental knowledge of Ethernet, TCP/IP, and basic switching concepts
* Development Tools: Familiarity with GCC, Make, debugging tools (GDB), and version control (Git)
* Operating Systems: Basic understanding of Linux kernel concepts and system programming
* Hardware Understanding: Basic knowledge of computer architecture, memory systems, and I/O interfaces


**Switching Domain Knowledge (Training Provided)**
* Willingness to learn switching architectures, ASIC programming, and packet processing concepts
* Interest in network protocols and enterprise switching features
* Basic understanding of OSI model and Ethernet fundamentals
* No prior Broadcom SDK experience required \- comprehensive training provided


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field

* Strong C programming skills demonstrated through coursework or projects
* Understanding of computer systems architecture and embedded systems concepts
* Good debugging and problem\-solving skills

description:
**About the role** 




 You’re the engine of the people team — sourcing and calling candidates, scheduling interviews, onboarding new joiners, keeping our HR systems accurate, and making sure engagement events actually happen. You’ll work directly with our HR Manager / People Partner, who sets the strategy; you make it run on the ground.
 



  





**About Hi Tours Group** 




 Hi Tours Group is a group of three specialized travel brands with 30\+ years of expertise spanning B2B, B2C, and corporate travel: Hi DMC (destination management for global tour operators and travel agents), Hi Tours (personalized leisure travel for modern explorers), and Hi Offsite (curated corporate offsites, incentives, and business travel). The group is IATA\-accredited and ISO 45001 and Travelife certified, and has served 100,000\+ travelers worldwide. More at hitours.group.
 



  





**Sourcing \& recruitment** 



* Source and screen candidates via LinkedIn, Naukri, and direct headhunting.
* Call and first\-screen candidates and schedule interviews with hiring managers.
* Maintain the candidate pipeline and talent pool in Recruit CRM / LinkedIn Recruiter.
* Collect candidate documents and keep recruitment trackers up to date across divisions.
* Coordinate day\-to\-day with external hiring partners (Manpower, Randstad).



**Onboarding** 



* Run pre\-onboarding follow\-ups and send appointment letters via Zoho Sign.
* Prepare Day\-1 schedules and coordinate with IT/Admin for laptops, email, access, and workspace.
* Lead tool walkthroughs (Zoho People, Mail, Cliq, Workdrive) and explain policies to new joiners.



**HR operations \& data** 



* Maintain the employee master data and records in Zoho People.
* Manage attendance, leave, and timesheets in Zoho People day to day, and prepare monthly payroll inputs (LOP, absences) for Accounts.
* Draft HR letters (offer, appointment, confirmation, experience, relieving) for sign\-off.
* Enter and track OKRs in Zoho People and keep the data clean and current.



**Exit** 



* Process resignations and run the exit checklist, asset recovery, and FnF input prep.



**Engagement, insurance \& PF** 



* Execute engagement events — birthdays, festivals, team activities — including vendor coordination.
* Manage insurance records (additions/deletions) and UAN/PF coordination via UMANG, KYC, and nominee follow\-ups.



**What you bring** 



* 2–4 years in recruitment or HR operations.
* Comfortable on the phone — you can cold\-call, screen, and follow up without hesitation.
* Organised and reliable — you keep trackers, documents, and data clean.
* Familiarity with HRMS / ATS tools — Recruit CRM and Zoho People are a strong plus.
* Clear communicator in English and Hindi.



**Nice to have** 



* Experience hiring for travel, hospitality, or services roles.
* Exposure to engagement / event coordination.



**First 6 months, success looks like** 



* A full, well\-maintained pipeline with fast scheduling and zero candidates dropped through the cracks.
* Onboarding and exits running smoothly without reminders.
* HR data in Zoho accurate enough that the People Partner never has to double\-check it.

title: People Operations
description:
We Are:
   

  

 At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self\-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high\-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
   

  

 You Are:
   

  

 You are an accomplished People Operations professional with a passion for transforming HR processes and enhancing employee experience at every stage of the lifecycle. Your expertise spans the full spectrum of HR, from Talent Acquisition and Onboarding to Performance Management, Total Rewards, Employee Relations, HR Operations, and Offboarding. You thrive in dynamic environments and excel at evaluating current\-state operations, identifying opportunities for improvement, and architecting scalable, future\-proof solutions that balance efficiency, compliance, and organizational effectiveness.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing:**
* Support large\-scale HR transformation initiatives such as shared services implementation, digital transformation, or post\-merger integration.

* Conduct comprehensive assessments of existing HR operations, identifying gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process harmonization and standardization.
* Develop structured process maps, workflow documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), job aids, templates, and toolkits to enable scalable, enterprise\-wide HR practices.
* Facilitate structured process discovery activities, including stakeholder interviews, cross\-functional workshops, and workflow analysis sessions to capture operational realities.
* Lead and manage cross\-functional HR transformation projects, including defining scope, setting milestones, managing project risks, and ensuring on\-time delivery of key initiatives.
* Partner with HR Centers of Excellence, HR Business Partners, Shared Services, and HRIS teams to align process design with technology enablement and service delivery models.


 The Impact You Will Have:
   

  

* Elevate the efficiency and effectiveness of HR operations, contributing directly to Synopsys’ ability to attract, engage, and retain top talent.
* Enhance employee experience by streamlining and standardizing critical HR processes across the organization.
* Drive process harmonization and reduce operational variability, enabling scalable growth and business agility.
* Enable data\-driven decision\-making through clear, structured process documentation and improved process visibility.
* Support compliance and risk mitigation by ensuring HR processes adhere to regulatory and organizational standards.
* Empower business leaders and HR stakeholders with tools and resources to effectively manage people practices in a rapidly evolving environment.


 What You’ll Need:
   

  

* Extensive experience of 8\-10 years leading HR process design, transformation, and optimization initiatives across the full employee lifecycle.
* Bachelor’s/ Masters’s degree in Human Resource or equivalent.
* Proven ability to evaluate current\-state HR operations and architect scalable, future\-state processes that drive efficiency and compliance.
* Deep expertise in developing enterprise\-grade HR documentation, including process maps, SOPs, job aids, and toolkits.
* Demonstrated ability to drive process harmonization across multiple business units, regions, or legacy operating models.
* Experience supporting large\-scale HR transformation initiatives such as shared services, operating model redesign, or digital transformation.
* Advanced analytical, written, and verbal communication skills; ability to translate complex workflows into clear, actionable documentation.


 Who You Are:
   

  

* A collaborative team player who thrives in matrixed and evolving environments.
* An effective communicator who can influence and build alignment with senior stakeholders.
* Detail\-oriented, analytical, and highly organized, with a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
* Adaptable and resilient, able to navigate ambiguity and drive change in fast\-paced settings.
* Empathetic, with a strong customer\-service orientation and a passion for enhancing the employee experience.
* Curious, proactive, and eager to stay at the forefront of HR innovation and best practices.


 The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:
   

  

 You’ll join a high\-impact, forward\-thinking People Operations team dedicated to driving HR excellence and transformation at Synopsys. The team collaborates closely with HR Centers of Excellence, Business Partners, Shared Services, and HRIS to deliver integrated, technology\-enabled solutions that support the company’s growth and strategic objectives. You’ll be surrounded by passionate professionals who are committed to continuous improvement and to making Synopsys a great place to work for all.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits:
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
